scope: Source/evidence audit only. No new game launches, implementations, stress tests or speedup measurements.
priorities: Order expresses expected scope and evidence, not measured recoverable cost. Overlapping packages are not additive.
acceptance: Each game neutral or positive. Small mixed samples inconclusive. Shared original/candidate defects are separate. Native saves protected; old save-state compatibility never required.

opportunities.title: Whole raster spans instead of one dot at a time
opportunities.remaining: HLE packs pixel state and the prior package fuses a CPU-cycle tail, but stable rendering still runs sprite evaluation, fetch, pixel composition, shifts and output at each dot. Replace a stable tile/row interval with one renderer plan plus the observable event schedule.
affected_profiles: SMB3 active MMC3 gameplay; SMB1 NROM control; subsequent affected cycle titles
opportunities.next_decisive_check: One post-delivery HLE SMB3 active-level inclusive profile; then prototype one complete stable interval and compare the built game against the already optimized HLE baseline.
opportunities.required_behavior: Correct pixels/opacity, sprite-zero and overflow publication, register effects, mapper address/IRQ events, Zapper light and current-build continuation. LLE remains a separate working reference.

opportunities.title: One CPU/device deadline service across multiple CPU cycles
opportunities.remaining: Generated CPU accesses still enter start/read-or-write/finish coordination. The existing optimization covers a tail within one CPU cycle. Consolidate ordinary execution and PPU/APU/mapper progress until the next actual bus/device/interrupt/host deadline.
affected_profiles: Current cycle games; NTSC first, PAL when selected
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Measure inclusive crossings in the same gameplay interval as NES01; implement a deadline-owned service rather than another callback-only fast path.
opportunities.required_behavior: NMI edge and IRQ poll ordering, DMA readiness, open bus, mapper clocks, observable accesses and hook/stop deadlines. An unchanged number of helper calls is not a contract.

opportunities.title: Integrated generated CPU blocks and ordinary memory service
opportunities.remaining: Static targets already use native gotos and ROM constants; RAM is already direct inside the bus router. Remaining work is cross-unit state traffic, instruction/chunk boundaries and repeated clock/bus guards. Revisit block/register ownership and observer-aware code generation as a coherent package.
affected_profiles: Current native cycle games and active mod/hook configurations
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Inspect one hot emitted block without editing it; attribute inclusive CPU/bus work after HLE and compare a regenerated fused-block experiment, not native coverage percentages.
opportunities.required_behavior: Interrupt boundaries, mapper writes and slot changes, hooks/read substitutions, self-modifying code, DMA and portable fallback. Fix the generator, never emitted C.

opportunities.title: Guarded native cartridge SRAM views
opportunities.remaining: The RAM-view physical mapping admits CPU RAM and FDS linear PRG RAM, not general cartridge RAM. Zelda copied routines remain a concrete candidate; a mapping-generation and write-watch contract can make them native without pretending SRAM is immutable.
affected_profiles: Zelda copied MMC1 SRAM code; other supported writable-code mappings conditionally
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Reuse beads-2dw.1.105; first attribute host CPU for the copied routines. Then qualify visible mapping, byte writes/debug pokes and PPU-edge read-gate changes on the supported MMC1 board.
opportunities.required_behavior: Every folded byte remains the visible byte, mapping/write changes exit or invalidate, restore revalidates and unsupported mappings interpret. Earlier 10.1% is emulated-cycle share, not possible CPU savings.

opportunities.title: Board and observer capabilities chosen at stable boundaries
opportunities.remaining: MMC1 map stability and inert read guards are already delivered. Remaining repeated ROM-snoop, board, cheat/data-overlay and device-observer decisions can be consolidated into a qualified service profile with invalidation when configuration changes.
affected_profiles: Boards/mod configurations with active versus absent read snoops, overlays and IRQ services
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Count and inclusively sample the active callbacks in the selected gameplay interval; only build a profile when it removes a material complete path.
opportunities.required_behavior: Bank-qualified cheats, data overlays, MMC5 read snoops, actual active board devices and configuration changes. Do not silently specialize away supported mods.

opportunities.title: Complete event-driven APU synthesis spans
opportunities.remaining: The accepted cache avoids recalculating base-channel level, but timers, sequencer/DMC checks, expansion sampling and accumulation still advance every CPU cycle. Give the next channel/register/DMC/sample event one owner and synthesize the interval.
affected_profiles: Audio-on cycle games; base APU first, expansion devices separately
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Use audio-on gameplay after the current cache, recording timer-event density and inclusive audio cost. Replace a whole interval, with rounding/accumulation handled deliberately.
opportunities.required_behavior: PCM, phase, output filters, envelopes, frame IRQ, DMC bus steals and controller delays. Exact old floating-point accumulation may require a matching arithmetic formulation or conservative fallback.

opportunities.title: Native DMA transfer service with exact device deadlines
opportunities.remaining: OAM and DMC DMA still traverse the ordinary cycle machinery. Consolidate safe transfer runs and device advancement rather than substituting an unqualified memcpy.
affected_profiles: Actual OAM/DMC-heavy gameplay; controller/Zapper interactions when affected
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Attribute a real DMA-heavy interval; reuse collision fixtures and test a transfer service only if the post-HLE share warrants it.
opportunities.required_behavior: Stolen cycles, CPU-held address, controller/register/open-bus reads, DMC/OAM collisions, interrupts and mapper observations.

opportunities.title: Qualified polling-loop and blank-interval fast forwarding
opportunities.remaining: Native code can still execute an expensive guest wait. A verified loop can advance to its first observable event while accounting for repeated reads and elapsed device work; rendering-off intervals are another opportunity.
affected_profiles: Content-qualified active-gameplay waits and rendering-off intervals
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Identify the exact active wait on gameplay traces. Reject menu/boot-only counts as gameplay attribution; prove a complete loop service on one content-qualified loop.
opportunities.required_behavior: Final registers/RAM, loop exit, side-effectful reads, interrupt sampling, device time and input latency. No arbitrary dropped cycles.

opportunities.title: Remaining hot ROM and RAM execution coverage
opportunities.remaining: Gumshoe received 2635 seeds in its accepted combined package. Other routes, titles, overlays and RAM images remain candidates only where meaningful hot execution still interprets.
affected_profiles: Routes/titles with observed hot ROM or RAM fallback; Gumshoe existing seed work is baseline
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Reuse bounded miss/capture logs from actual affected gameplay. Regenerate through the supported pipeline and measure the game; already near-100%-native SMB routes are not coverage projects.
opportunities.required_behavior: Reachable content/byte identities, writes, fallback behavior and normal game progression; no percentage gain from a coverage counter alone.

opportunities.title: Whole game-service native replacements
opportunities.remaining: Trusted hooks provide a boundary for content-qualified native decompression, tile streaming, collision or entity update services. Translating the old instruction algorithm is not the only allowed implementation.
affected_profiles: A title with a demonstrated expensive decompression/streaming/collision/entity service
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Choose a repeatedly expensive service from an actual title profile, verify the ROM/disassembly contract, and replace the complete job rather than selected opcodes.
opportunities.required_behavior: Inputs/outputs, shared RAM, RNG, relevant timing/device effects and failure paths; unsupported content keeps the original path. No guessed game logic.

opportunities.title: One stock/custom rendering product pipeline
opportunities.remaining: A wide/custom view is composed after stock products exist. The old pixel-bypass rejection protected real observations, but did not evaluate a replacement that computes required status/mapper/light/pixel products once and feeds the final view directly.
affected_profiles: SMB1/SMB3/Metroid custom wide views; Zelda custom views; Zapper-aware consumers
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Map every actual consumer of stock color, background opacity and line history in one widened profile; build one shared plan/output path with semantic fallback at unsupported raster effects.
opportunities.required_behavior: Required screenshots/raw pixels, collision/status consumers, mid-frame effects, Zapper and mapper events. Avoiding duplicate work does not mean dropping those products.

opportunities.title: Shared CHR/nametable/OAM preparation by mutation generation
opportunities.remaining: Custom render helpers repeatedly decode rows and colors. Build reusable tile/row and sprite plans keyed to actual CHR, bank, nametable, palette and OAM revisions; share them with wide/HD/voxel consumers where contracts agree.
affected_profiles: Custom wide, HD and voxel consumers with repeated tile/sprite preparation
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Measure repeated decode/preparation in the chosen full-view job; reuse previous CHR-shortcut prototypes only after auditing their invalidation and unqualified timing status.
opportunities.required_behavior: CHR RAM writes/bank changes, palette/scanline state, flips, clipping, transparency, sprite order and restore invalidation.

opportunities.title: HD recording as compact tile/run records
opportunities.remaining: Active HD copies fetched-tile structures into eight lanes, shifts sixteen entries per half-dot and copies tile keys/palettes into per-pixel records. Replace repeated metadata movement with immutable tile identities, indices and run/event references.
affected_profiles: Zelda Remastered active HD; other real enabled HD packs
opportunities.next_decisive_check: One real Zelda Remastered gameplay interval: separate recording from sampling cost, then replace the complete recording-to-sampler representation.
opportunities.required_behavior: Bytes actually fetched across mid-tile bank/CHR changes, palette timing, sprite priority, masks/emphasis, exact native fallback and current-build saves.

opportunities.title: HD lookup, conditions and composition as one render job
opportunities.remaining: A full recorded frame is adapted into shared pixel descriptors and then sampled/upscaled. Consolidate tile-key lookup, condition dependency evaluation, background layers and output runs; GPU-resident pack composition is a possible backend, not a requirement.
affected_profiles: Same real active HD-pack gameplay as NES13
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Use the same real-pack interval as NES13. Attribute recording/condition/lookup/blend costs and compare one complete render job with the existing sampler.
opportunities.required_behavior: All supported condition semantics, sprite/background blending and fallback pixels; do not claim unsupported pack audio or conditions become implemented.

opportunities.title: Replace the copy-based presentation compatibility bridge
opportunities.remaining: The bridge copies OAM/nametable/palette and reads 8192 CHR bytes into legacy-shaped globals. Expose one immutable frame/mapping view or revision-aware update service to consumers instead of rebuilding all compatibility products at every sync.
affected_profiles: Cycle custom/HD/voxel callers of cyc_presentation_sync
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Audit sync callers in one wide/voxel/HD frame, count repeated products and measure inclusive bridge plus consumer preparation.
opportunities.required_behavior: Consumers see the correct completed-frame/mapping data, live bank/CHR changes and state restores; keep an adapter for unported consumers.

opportunities.title: Whole-view widescreen preparation and span composition
opportunities.remaining: The canvas is cleared, margins reconstructed and sprites decoded/composited on each new frame. Use one view plan, clipped spans and explicit dirty products rather than separate native-center and margin work.
affected_profiles: SMB1/SMB3/Metroid/Gumshoe real widened gameplay and Fit resizing
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Attribute a real 21:9/32:9 moving-camera interval and compare the full view, including changing window aspect and composed HUD.
opportunities.required_behavior: Real margin content, entity visibility, priority, camera wrap, HUD placement and arbitrary Fit resize behavior; no black-margin speedup.

opportunities.title: Retained voxel terrain and sprite assembly
opportunities.remaining: Terrain generation, tile materials, sprite grouping and contact shadows are a larger complete job than an isolated triangle helper. Retain static geometry/materials and update changed actors/camera-dependent products.
affected_profiles: Zelda/Metroid/other supported voxel diorama and first-person modes
opportunities.next_decisive_check: One active voxel room with camera motion and animated terrain; distinguish geometry construction, rasterization and sprite assembly before choosing retained CPU meshes or an optional GPU backend.
opportunities.required_behavior: Tile heights, clipping, transparent cards, actor grouping, proportional shadows, HUD and camera/input behavior. Shared Metroid restore defect remains separate.

opportunities.title: Persistent neighboring-room simulation service

evidence.symbol: Visible region plus one room beyond the view.

opportunities.remaining: Each eligible neighboring room installs local RAM into an isolated machine, calls translated entity logic, captures it and restores the host. Visible-plus-adjacent activation already exists; making it newly distance-limited is not a new optimization. Build persistent room contexts and a consolidated update job, optionally replacing qualified entity services natively.
affected_profiles: Zelda Seamless Overworld ordinary Fit, dungeon and atlas modes
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Reuse zelda_world_timing for ordinary Fit and atlas views; split room updates, isolation copies and guest execution. Compare the complete neighbor-update service with identical actors/ticks.
opportunities.required_behavior: Visible/adjacent actors still update before entry, RNG and timers remain consistent, room handoffs/doors/portals and shared progress remain correct. Slowing simulation is not equivalent performance.

opportunities.title: Persistent world raster/material products
opportunities.remaining: Room rasters are already cached. Remaining candidates are sharing unchanged world/material products across camera moves, preparing visible runs once and updating actor overlays without repainting every large atlas pixel.
affected_profiles: Zelda Seamless Fit/dungeon/atlas; bomb/menu/death presentation
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Use the same Fit/atlas interval as NES18 and separate already-cached terrain from final draw/upload cost.
opportunities.required_behavior: Bomb-wide flash, inventory/death/Continue framing, arbitrary aspect, palettes, changing tiles and dungeon doors remain correct. Do not reintroduce 4:3 transitions.

opportunities.title: Replace full-machine isolation copy/restore with explicit ownership
opportunities.remaining: Isolated helpers copy CPU/hardware/cart/PPU/APU/media state and restore it. A declared mutation domain, persistent scratch context or write journal can eliminate repeated full snapshots as part of the room/service architecture.
affected_profiles: Zelda room updates and other supported isolated guest-service callers
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Measure scopes and copied regions in NES18; compare one persistent service context rather than another allocation-only experiment.
opportunities.required_behavior: No leaked device clocks, native saves, inventory/shared progress or media/audio changes; refusal of forbidden effects and exact authoritative host continuation.

opportunities.title: One authoritative state image for save, rewind and mod records
opportunities.remaining: State serialization still copies machine/cart/frame products plus host/mod payloads. Prior fused digest and inactive-HD work are already baseline. Evaluate immutable frame images, mutation generations and derived-product reconstruction across the complete capture/restore lifetime.
affected_profiles: Current-build save/rewind-heavy games; active HD/world records when enabled
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Measure a current-build rewind/snapshot-heavy workload, including active HD/world mods, copied bytes, resident memory and tail latency. Reuse rejected scratch/allocation evidence.
opportunities.required_behavior: Current-build save/load/rewind correctness and malformed-input rejection; persistent native saves protected. Old-state compatibility, old layout and private cache byte identity are not requirements.

opportunities.title: Rollback capture/digest/replay ownership
opportunities.remaining: The prior fused digest and presentation-skipping replay must not be credited again. Remaining candidates are common authoritative capture ownership, changed-region hashing and avoiding duplicate host/mod reconstruction during actual delayed-peer replay.
affected_profiles: Actual delayed-peer cycle netplay and current-build replay
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Only if netplay is selected: one real delayed-peer workload with actual replay ticks and full endpoint-state/digest checks. Do not infer rollback cost from offline snapshots.
opportunities.required_behavior: Deterministic peer input, current-build restore, all authoritative state and before-frame-0 capability/profile agreement; same-host checks do not establish cross-build compatibility.

opportunities.title: Observer/history work integrated with semantic events
opportunities.remaining: Offline timed builds disable optional cycle tracing, but ordinary device history remains active. Netplay explicitly enables cycle tracing as a simulation setting. Derive required history/digests at semantic service boundaries and separate them from trace-detail production; preserve useful diagnostics rather than pretending legacy CMake keys disable the cycle ring.
affected_profiles: Offline production history and netplay trace/digest consumers, measured separately
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Measure offline history and actual netplay trace/digest cost separately after the larger ownership decision. Keep qualification observers out of timed binaries and verify required diagnostic/digest results separately.
opportunities.required_behavior: Required fault information, ring consumers, hooks and agreed peer digests remain correct. Do not disable netplay hashing unilaterally; establish a common validated profile before changing its simulation identity.

opportunities.title: Frame conversion, texture upload and GPU residency
opportunities.remaining: Generation reuse for repeated paused presents already exists. Each new picture still goes through full texture upload. Consider indexed-palette presentation, dirty-region upload or direct resident render products together with the compositor.
affected_profiles: Actual SDL stock/wide/HD/voxel presentation; software and selected GPU backend
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Measure actual active SDL/GPU presentation at stock and one expanded/HD size. Include upload, driver waits and UI composition; headless CRC throughput cannot select this.
opportunities.required_behavior: Palette/emphasis, screenshots, filters, resize, UI/HUD and output latency; retain software presentation and supported-platform fallback.

opportunities.title: Audio host buffering and queue ownership
opportunities.remaining: Separate generated PCM cost from draining/copying/queueing output. Consolidate buffers or callback ownership only when they cause meaningful CPU or underruns; the earlier desktop queue share was small.
affected_profiles: Real audio-device gameplay; queues/underruns distinct from dummy output timing
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Observe queue depth, underruns and output-thread CPU on actual audio-on gameplay, separately from dummy-device simulation timing.
opportunities.required_behavior: PCM, latency, pause/resume, volume and fast-forward behavior; muting or disabling emulation is not an optimization win.

opportunities.title: Pacing and presentation deadlines
opportunities.remaining: A previous waitable-pacing candidate reduced CPU but worsened deadline lateness. A revised service can coordinate audio/video/input deadlines without busy wait or repeated synchronous presentation.
affected_profiles: Normal paced play, fast-forward and slow-display presentation
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Reuse the negative receipt first; only test a materially different deadline design. Compare p95/p99 lateness, cadence and input latency as well as CPU.
opportunities.required_behavior: No worse user-visible pacing/latency or broken fast-forward. Retain the earlier failed candidate as rejected, not an open ready-to-ship win.

opportunities.title: Compiler policy and generated-code layout
opportunities.remaining: PGO, hot/cold layout, translation-unit/block layout and supported selective IPO can improve native locality and cross-unit optimization. Global IPO has a real SMB1 Fit divergence; native-C-only IPO had functional support but no admitted timing gain.
affected_profiles: SMB1 Fit defect; current gameplay-trained compiler policies across affected consumers
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Reuse beads-2dw.1.106 and existing binaries. Diagnose the actual aliasing/lifetime/optimizer defect before global IPO; use current gameplay-trained PGO or layout candidates only after the larger pipeline decision.
opportunities.required_behavior: Every affected game remains neutral or positive and correct; generated coverage/build size are not vetoes by themselves, but startup/memory costs must be recorded.

opportunities.title: Parallel immutable visual jobs
opportunities.remaining: After ownership consolidation, independent tile preparation, HD composition or voxel work can use immutable frame products on workers. Adding threads to shared mutable machine state is not the first step.
affected_profiles: A measured independent HD/wide/voxel visual job after immutable ownership exists
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Only after measuring a large parallelizable render job: compare complete frame latency, CPU and RSS against the simpler serial replacement.
opportunities.required_behavior: Deterministic authoritative simulation, no races/lifetime errors, bounded queues and acceptable latency; serial portable fallback remains usable.

opportunities.title: FDS BIOS, disk transfer and RAM publication as native services

evidence.symbol: the Famicom Disk System HLE tier
The frame just run was part of a disk load

opportunities.remaining: Cartridge NES games have no common BIOS to consolidate. FDS does: current HLE observes ID/load spans, auto-swaps and removes host pacing during loading while retaining the low-level drive/recompiled BIOS. A true BIOS/media service and loaded-image preparation are a separate larger opportunity.
affected_profiles: FDS inventory only: Otocky/Esper Dream/Nazo no Murasame-jou when owner reopens scope
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Inventory only. Earlier owner instructions excluded further FDS validation; no FDS launch or promotion unless that scope is reopened. Then select one actual loading-to-gameplay interval.
opportunities.required_behavior: Disk files/status/errors, writes/native progress, side routing, RAM publication and game-visible completion/interrupt timing; distinguish CPU savings from an elective faster-loading behavior change.

opportunities.title: Expansion-audio and complex-board event services
opportunities.remaining: FDS/VRC6/VRC7/Namco/FME-7 and MMC5-specific work has different timer, sampling and bus-observer costs. Build event-driven board/audio services where an actually supported title spends time, not a generic callback cleanup.
affected_profiles: A supported title using MMC5 or VRC/Namco/FME-7 expansion services; FDS parked
opportunities.next_decisive_check: A matching supported board workload and one inclusive service attribution. Reuse existing board fixtures; no all-mapper matrix merely to rank a candidate.
opportunities.required_behavior: Expansion PCM, board IRQ/read gating and register timing, device state and portable execution. FDS-specific work remains parked with NES29.

opportunities.title: Startup, native code footprint and first-use stalls

evidence.symbol: one labeled block per ROM instruction

opportunities.remaining: Larger generated programs and boot-time RAM-view indexes can affect startup, RSS and first-use page faults even when steady gameplay is fast. Deduplicate cold metadata and lay out hot native blocks as one startup/execution design.
affected_profiles: A supported title with reported/measured startup or first-use stalls
opportunities.next_decisive_check: Only if startup or first-use delay is reported or visible in the selected interval; distinguish generation/build time, launcher time and game runtime. No menu-only throughput campaign.
opportunities.required_behavior: Same ROM/content validation, working fallback, actual game start and persistent settings/saves. Longer generation and a larger binary alone do not disqualify useful built-runtime gains.

execution.first_selection: Native stable-interval CPU/memory/PPU/APU service; whole-goal scope remains NES01-NES31
